description: Check DNS records (TXT ownership record and CNAME or flattened A/AAAA record) for a link page’s saved custom domain on Pro. Once verified, the custom domain serves the link page, blog and media kit live with white-label branding and canonical URLs.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

id.description: A page id from links_list that has a custom domain saved with links_domain_set.

name: links_domain_verify
title: Verify custom domain DNS
